title: oven-sh/bun Bun v1.2.8
summary:
To install Bun v1.2.8
bash
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
or you can use npm
npm install -g bun
Windows:
bash
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1|iex"
To upgrade to Bun v1.2.8:
bash
bun upgrade
